answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation slot binding: each agent locks a bond that decays by a fixed delta per epoch unless renewed by verified peer attestations. New identities start on an isolated island with zero trust weight, so spawning many costs real stake per identity. Attestations form a trellis of cross-vouches, and colluding clusters get diluted because trust flows only through independent, bonded peers. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
